title: Detached Workflow Run Recovery
gradingCriteria: Identifies that most work is already complete and retained in `journal.json`; the priority is to preserve journal reuse rather than restarting from scratch.
Distinguishes the failed schema-validation agent from the long-silent running agent and treats them as separate recovery decisions.
Recommends inspecting status/logs for the silent agent before killing the whole run, then stopping or restarting only the stuck agent if it has no progress.

Uses resume or admission controls in a sequence that avoids losing completed work: stop failed/stuck agents as needed, fix or narrow the workflow prompt if required, then `agent-workflows resume <runId>` or resume admission to replay cached completed calls.
Explains that `result.json` missing means the synthesis/final phase has not completed, not that the completed analyses are gone.

Includes a practical stop condition: if resume repeatedly fails on the same schema field or agent, patch the workflow/schema prompt or synthesize from completed valid outputs rather than repeatedly re-running the whole audit.
